李陽奈.definition: A glance at the glowing smile [on your face] brings me instant joy on my worst days. [Everything] about you has filled my heart. Be mine forever, or let me be yours forever. I promise to walk with you throughout our journey to eternity. [I promise I] won't get you out of my heart until my soul is out of my body.
